A requested catch-up can continue after screen-off on a permitted connection. Once Core confirms the peer tip, it stops; Android then schedules inexact chain checks at least 15 minutes apart. Background checks do not unlock the wallet. Balances and payment alerts remain dated until you open and unlock it. Android may delay or stop a check; battery savings have not been measured.

A saved full address never changes when its shortname changes. Last checked names come from the Blocknet ID HTTPS service; they are not independently authenticated. Names are checked before using one to send. Automatic checks cover at most two stale names per network per day after a live unlock over a permitted connection.
